name: Veggie Ground, Portobello, Edamame & Zucchini Noodle Soup with Sesame
ingredients: 64 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Remove stems and scrape out the gills of the mushrooms; small dice, place in a medium bowl, and set aside.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl with the mushrooms and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggie ground, salt, and pepper; cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and garlic; add both to the bowl with the other veggies.
When the veggie ground is done, add mushrooms, carrot, ginger, and garlic to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are soft and fragrant, 3-4 minutes.

Add broth, edamame, and soy sauce to the pot; stir to combine, cover, and bring the soup to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until flavors blend, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim zucchini and use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles.
When the soup is done, add zucchini noodles to the pot, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls, drizzle with oil, and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
